notes:
### Fixed
- **Scan captures crop to the guide.** The capture margin is now 5% per side
  (`SCAN_FRAME_MARGIN` 0.12 → 0.05), so the saved JPEG is the guide plus a small
  invisible tolerance instead of ~97% of the screen width. The guide is fitted
  to short/landscape viewports (78% width remains the portrait cap), and the
  matcher's guide prior uses the same margin.
- A capture whose guide crop cannot be measured now aborts with a transient
  "Could not frame the camera" warning instead of silently saving the full
  frame, and a rotated ImageCapture still falls back to the preview-frame crop.

No scan-index rebuild required (the descriptor and `SCAN_VERSION` are unchanged;
the margin is not part of the index format).
